name: Ledgerler
summary: Bank and ledger reconciliation and month-end close for small businesses and bookkeepers. Its deterministic matching engine is a public HTTP API (POST /api/v1/match) that is free and keyless on the free tier (20 requests per hour per IP): send bank and ledger lines, get back matched groups each with a method and a confidence score, every unmatched line listed, and a summary with a match rate and the residual difference. Also a client-side browser tool and a month-end close checklist with sign-off and an audit trail (Pro). The site advertises 'MCP tools', but no MCP server is discoverable.

agentAccess.notes: Measured keyless 2026-11-12 18:20Z: POST www.ledgerler.com/api/v1/match, no signup, no key, answered 200 with matched groups and a summary.matchRate. Free tier is 20 requests/hour/IP (429 over). No MCP server found: /mcp, /api/v1/mcp, /api/mcp all 404. API keys with higher limits 'planned' for Pro.

jobs.summary: Deterministic matching engine, measured keyless: POST /api/v1/match returns matched groups (method + confidence), every unmatched line, and a summary with matchRate and residual difference. No aggregate match-rate, unreconciled-items or hours figure is published.

payments.notes: Free plan ($0): 1 entity, 2 accounts, 3 reconciliations/month, 3 saved match rules, 1 close checklist, and the public matching API. Pro $29/mo or $290/yr makes entities, accounts, reconciliations, match rules and checklists unlimited and adds CSV export and audit trail. The pricing page names no payment method, so humanBilling is unknown.
